assessment: This manuscript presents DATES, a robust method to infer the timing of admixture events using genetic data from present-day or ancient (with paleogenomics data) individuals. In the study, DATES is applied to >1000 ancient human genomes to characterize major admixture events during the European Holocene. This work will be of interest to scholars in the fields of population genetics, paleogenomics, archeology, biological anthropology, and history.
